conditions.rendering: Original GLTF materials, neutral diagnostic hemisphere and directional illumination; no authored ground or night fixtures
conditions.externalNetwork: All viewer, decoder and geometry resources are served by local HTTP.

sourceCredit: Kyoto City / MLIT Project PLATEAU, CC BY 4.0
limitations: Source qualification images; no production renderer comparison or performance acceptance.
Camera anchors use provisional source heights; surveyed pedestrian ground and current facade identity remain unqualified.
The 25 m acquisition index is bounded; absent distant context and opposite wards remain visible source gaps.

captures.source: Actual local Chromium rendering of the bound PLATEAU source package
captures.rights: Derived source diagnostic; Kyoto City / MLIT Project PLATEAU, CC BY 4.0
captures.method: Playwright JPEG screenshot, quality 92, after selected camera pose and subsequent submitted draws
captures.limitations: Provisional source-height camera; original acquired geometry without ground repair; no physical GPU or realism acceptance

pose.heightMethod: Minimum actual decoded vertex height of nearest projected building surface; provisional diagnostic anchor
pose.verticalDatum: WGS84 ellipsoidal local tangent frame with origin height zero; CityGML orthometric source heights retained separately
pose.limitations: Review camera placement only; pedestrian ground, traversability and current appearance remain unqualified.

pixels.method: Native browser JPEG decode; interior pixels sampled every five pixels and quantized to 16 levels per RGB channel
